deployments_detail.use: Launched "Akdital Innov" subsidiary (Apr 2026) for AI in care: AI-assisted surgery, digital twins & virtual clinical trials, predictive/early-detection, telemedicine; CEO-disclosed

AI-assisted radiology imaging analysis for early breast-cancer detection, delivered through the Akdital INNOV center of excellence (analysis of large volumes of CT/MRI/mammography images to flag abnormalities, with the radiologist retaining final decision). [Dassault Systemes (3DEXPERIENCE); Long Island University (training/knowledge transfer)]
AI-driven early detection of cardiovascular disease via intelligent analysis of massive clinical/imaging datasets, as a priority focus of the Akdital INNOV center of excellence. [Dassault Systemes]

Digital twins (virtual replicas) of patient organs used to simulate surgical procedures and plan/prepare interventions and post-operative treatment. [Dassault Systemes (3DEXPERIENCE); Medidata (Dassault subsidiary)]

Virtual (in silico) clinical trials using digital twins built from real patient medical data, to simulate treatment effects without traditional clinical trials. [Dassault Systemes / Medidata; Biovia; academic support from Harvard University and Long Island University]

AI clinical decision support: exploiting health data to analyze clinical situations, prioritize (triage) cases, and optimize patient care pathways for predictive medicine. [Akdital INNOV (Dassault Systemes ecosystem)]

AI-enhanced precision surgery, positioned as one of the three roadmap pillars of Akdital INNOV (AI supporting surgical practice; the group already operates the Da Vinci Xi surgical robot). [Dassault Systemes; Intuitive Surgical (Da Vinci Xi robotic platform)]
Personalized, AI-enabled patient monitoring and individualized follow-up care through connected digital tools (part of the digitized, connected care pathway). [Akdital INNOV]
Telemedicine / remote-care access using AI and digital tools to extend specialist care to isolated regions of Morocco. [Akdital INNOV (Dassault Systemes)]

Physician/staff upskilling and training on AI and digital-health engineering via knowledge transfer from Long Island University into the Dassault center of excellence. [Long Island University; Dassault Systemes]
